title: SEKA Rapier Handlebar official store page
notes: Spear's one-piece Rapier bar in 19 width-stem sizes measured at the hood position: 360 mm with 80–110 mm stems, 375 mm with 80–130 mm, 395 mm with 90–130 mm and 415 mm with 100–130 mm. Sold separately at USD 499. Product photos show the bar fitted to a Spear RDC front end.
